text:
kevin: saw a late-night OOM on a 64GB node during low traffic. preliminary: kv_residency never decreased after stream disconnect; fragmentation ticked up. posting quick follow-ups.

anya: please drop the short checklist so I can schedule the config roll.

lee: quick datapoints: kv_residency_count +22% over 3h, jemalloc.retained / rss ~= 1.12, no obvious leak traces in app logs. attaching small heap snapshot link in perf bucket.

kevin: actions: A1: collect jemalloc stats + per-arena dumps on affected canaries (owner: @lee, due: 2026-03-12). A2: push idle-evict TTL 20m in staging (owner: @anya, due: 2026-03-10). A3: enable lightweight background compaction with 5% CPU cap behind flag (owner: @kevin, due: 2026-03-20). A4: add alert kv_residency_delta > 15%/2h (owner: @runbooks, due: 2026-03-09).

lee: started A1; uploading to gs://redwood-perf/oom/2912345678/ now.

anya: scheduling A2 for 2026-03-10 02:00 UTC to staging; will run 4h smoke and post metrics (kv_residency_size, kv_fragmentation, p95).

diag-bot: deploy-notice: staging_config_change by anya scheduled 2026-03-10 02:00 UTC. CI: green.

kevin: rollout policy: config-only canary at 10% traffic, monitor p95 and error-rate for 2h. rollback if p95 > baseline+25ms or error-rate spike > 0.5%. compaction is higher risk; keep behind feature flag and canary traffic at 5%.

runbooks: updated "shard-residency-watch" runbook with steps to run A1, flip idle-evict, and escalation to eng-runtime on trend > +15%/2h. heuristic added: if jemalloc.retained / rss > 1.1 prioritize compaction.

kevin: quick note: prefer compaction over aggressive eviction when fragmentation ratio high; eviction can cause cache churn and higher downstream latency.

anya: ack, will validate staging results and attach graphs.

lee: will post heap diffs and flamegraphs once uploads complete.

kevin: reconvene Mon 2026-03-15 15:00 UTC if staging shows residual growth. update thread with blockers. :white_check_mark:
